about: A library of the Blender Foundation's open movies, for screenshots. Every image is taken from Wikimedia Commons, which records its licence; fetch.py refuses any that is not CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC0 or public domain, and writes the credits. Years, running times and directors are the films' own; the summaries are written for Omafin. No ratings are given, since none would be ours to give.

films.name: Elephants Dream
films.overview: Old Proog leads young Emo through a vast, shifting machine that may exist only in Proog's mind. The first of the Blender open movies.

films.name: Big Buck Bunny
films.overview: A gentle giant of a rabbit has his quiet day in the meadow ruined by three bullying rodents, and sets out to get even.

films.name: Sintel
films.overview: A lone young woman searches the frozen wilds for the baby dragon she once rescued, raised and lost.

films.name: Tears of Steel
films.overview: In a future Amsterdam, a band of scientists and fighters stage one moment from the past again, hoping to save the world from the robots.

films.name: Cosmos Laundromat
films.overview: On a desolate island, a weary sheep called Franck meets a salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime.

films.name: Spring
films.overview: A shepherd girl and her dog face the ancient spirits of the mountain to keep the cycle of life turning.

films.name: Coffee Run
films.overview: Fuelled by caffeine, a young woman runs through the bittersweet memories of her past.

films.name: Sprite Fright
films.overview: Rowdy teenagers camping in a quiet forest find tiny mushroom sprites, who turn out to be far less harmless than they look.

films.name: Charge
films.overview: In a world short of power, an old man breaks into a guarded energy plant.
